## Summary

## Validation

- [ ] Inputs remain read-only and outputs remain non-overwriting.
- [ ] Scientific wording and units remain within the documented boundaries.
- [ ] Machine fields, JSON keys, statuses, formulas, and filenames remain stable.
- [ ] Chinese/English user-visible strings and placeholders were reviewed.
- [ ] Relevant tests pass in the supported QGIS runtime.
- [ ] No private data, credentials, local profiles, or unclear-license assets were added.
